integrity: All theorem parameters, equality cases, and numerical instances are derived analytically and reproducibly; no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Does not address tree edge-reweighting, arbitrary sparse SPD preconditioners, graph-wide runtime guarantees, or priority against all historical cycle-space literature. Finite numerical checks supplement, not replace, exact proof.
scientific_scope: Pathwise positive homogeneous edge conductances on simple three-arm theta graphs; inherited-weight unscaled spanning-tree preconditioners; positive generalized spectral condition number and total weighted stretch.
title: Sharp stretch-versus-condition-number separation in weighted theta-graph tree preconditioning
